en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a bustling town square with horse-drawn carts and carriages in front of multi‑story historic buildings with shops at street level. Large neoclassical façades with columns line the right side; smaller houses and commercial buildings frame the left. The caption at the top reads "Mediaș – Mediasch". The reverse side carries the printed heading "România / Cartă Postală" and publisher information at the bottom.
